## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Measurement impact

State whether the change affects a runner, method, schema, score, source lock, or result artifact. If it does, link the separate measurement review and versioned result-governance evidence.

## Validation

List the commands or checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows the applicable path license in `LICENSES/README.md`.
- [ ] Every new commit contains a `Signed-off-by` trailer under [DCO 1.1](../DCO).
- [ ] Published results are not overwritten; accepted corrections use versioned artifacts and supersession links.
- [ ] No datasets, raw runs, logs, model caches, credentials, private data, or local paths are included.
